zh.title: 审查闭环：三条链路按证据收口
highlights: Java 项目的验证命令终于算数：dotnet、maven、gradle 的测试与构建会被交付门正确识别；多模块仓的局部跑不再被记成全量证据。
全量失败不再自动变黄：没有外部在途改动证据时保持红灯并指引取证；会话中途 git init 的项目可以现场重采基线交付。
多会话接管不留缝：判定后对方又写了文件就放弃接管；.env 等被忽略文件不再被当成「干净」误夺。未授信项目的 recall 不再读仓库自带的 commit 事实，你的全局技能恢复可用。
zh.notice: 交付门黄灯现在需要外部在途改动的证据；自己的回归仍是红灯。~/.rivet 请勿做成符号链接（serve 会拒绝启动）；桌面扫码配对只在独立 TLS 服务下可用。

en.title: Audit hardening: evidence-based gates
highlights: Java builds finally count: dotnet, maven and gradle test/build commands are recognized by the delivery gate, and partial reactor runs in multi-module repos are no longer logged as full-suite evidence.

Full-suite failures no longer auto-downgrade: without evidence of external in-flight changes the gate stays red and tells you how to prove it; a session that git-inits mid-task can recapture its baseline and deliver.

Multi-session takeover leaves no gaps: if the owner refreshes the file after the check, the takeover is cancelled; ignored files like .env are no longer treated as clean. Recall no longer reads repo-shipped commit facts in untrusted projects, while your global skills work again.
en.notice: A yellow delivery gate now requires evidence of external in-flight changes; your own regressions stay red. Do not symlink ~/.rivet (serve refuses to start); phone pairing via QR is only available on a standalone TLS serve.
